description:
The process begins when a customer files a complaint about a product or service.
Customer service logs the complaint and assigns it to the relevant department for investigation.
After reviewing the details, the team determines whether the complaint is valid and whether a refund is justified and notifies the customer with the decision.
If a refund is approved, the financial team processes the reimbursement.
The complaint is marked as resolved once the customer receives the refund or directly after notifying the customer in case the refund was rejected.
After resolving the case, customers can provide feedback on their satisfaction.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Complaint" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/complaint">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Complaint" name="Complaint filed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RefundApproved" name="Refund approved notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RefundRejected" name="Refund rejected notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Feedback" name="Satisfaction feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Flow_MsgComplaint" name="Complaint filed" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_ComplaintFiled"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Flow_MsgRefundApproved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Task_NotifyApproval" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Flow_MsgRefundRejected" name="Refund rejected" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRejection" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Flow_MsgFeedback" name="Feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Catch_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Complaint Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Complaint">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CustomerService" name="Customer Service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_ComplaintFiled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ResolveMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_Feedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordFeedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ComplaintClosed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Department" name="Relevant Department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Investigate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewValidity</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyApproval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyRejection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Finance" name="Financial Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessReimbursement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ComplaintFiled" name="Complaint filed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ComplaintFiled" messageRef="Msg_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AssignComplaint" name="Assign complaint to relevant department"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Investigate" name="Investigate complaint details"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewValidity" name="Determine complaint validity and refund justification"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_RefundRejected"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyApproval" name="Notify customer of approved refund" messageRef="Msg_RefundApproved"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessReimbursement" name="Process reimbursement"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyRejection" name="Notify customer of rejected refund" messageRef="Msg_RefundRejected"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ResolveMerge" name="Ready to resolve"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Feedback" name="Customer feedback received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Feedback" messageRef="Msg_Feedback"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordFeedback" name="Record customer satisfaction feedback"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ComplaintClosed" name="Complaint case closed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ComplaintFiled" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_Investigate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_Investigate" targetRef="Task_ReviewValidity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ReviewValidity" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundApproved" name="Refund approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_NotifyApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundRejected" name="Refund rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_NotifyRejection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_NotifyApproval" targetRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" targetRef="Gateway_ResolveMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRejection" targetRef="Gateway_ResolveMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_ResolveMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="Catch_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Catch_Feedback" targetRef="Task_RecordFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_RecordFeedback" targetRef="End_ComplaintClosed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
